sampling: Exclude all 200 earlier natural candidates and 64 citation candidates; SHA256([seed,id])-order remaining 7141 IDs; first 32 eligible among first 200. No labels or model outcomes in selection.
prompt: Fixed natural_repetition.SYSTEM plus citation_interface_v2.EXPLICIT; generic json_object, no grammar treatment.
replay: Original complete source sequence plus supplementary block containing lexical top three sentences twice. No gold-based selection.
position: Move those top three sentences, in lexical rank order, to the end exactly once; no new evidence or copies.
padding: Original complete source sequence plus the same supplementary block header and six punctuation-only rows explicitly marked non-evidence. Deterministic label-free tokenizer search freezes a full-prompt token match to replay before inference; recheck after actual S0 and fail rather than retune if mismatched.
limits: Repetition changes salience and sequence length; punctuation is not semantically neutral and cannot isolate statistical double-counting.
Private S0 then all-context reconsideration is a replayed evidence-sharing diagnostic, not regenerated peer debate, independence certification or a DICE efficacy test.
Three recipients are clustered within each question, not independent observations.
Single-union and question-only are references, not equal-compute treatment controls.
Invalid outputs score zero for all-planned pipeline metrics; failures block complete scoring, never imputed.
No confidence or calibration outcome is collected. No retries, output repair, truncation, seed changes, effect-based stopping, or automated further batch.
decision: Read completed coverage and all prespecified question-level contrasts before designing anything further. Discuss an inconclusive or adverse result without selectively scaling a promising arm. No efficacy gate or confirmation claim is created post hoc.
